Body Slam.name: Body Slam
Body Slam.desc: Leaps and slams its full weight onto the target. 30% chance to paralyze.

Double-Edge.name: Double-Edge
Double-Edge.desc: A reckless full-body charge. The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt as recoil.

Earth Power.name: Earth Power
Earth Power.desc: The ground under the target cracks and erupts. 10% chance to lower its Sp. Def. Move away to avoid it.

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.desc: A shockwave rolls out across the ground. Pokémon in the air avoid it; hits a digging Pokémon for double damage.

Frenzy Plant.name: Frenzy Plant
Frenzy Plant.desc: Huge roots burst up and batter the target. Leaves the user unable to act for a moment afterwards.

Giga Impact.name: Giga Impact
Giga Impact.desc: An all-out charging slam. Leaves the user unable to act for 2 seconds afterwards.

Hyper Beam.name: Hyper Beam
Hyper Beam.desc: Charges up, then fires a huge beam. Leaves the user unable to act for a moment afterwards.

Leaf Storm.name: Leaf Storm
Leaf Storm.desc: Unleashes a huge cone of whirling leaves. Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

Leech Seed.name: Leech Seed
Leech Seed.desc: Plants a seed that drains 1/8 of the target's max HP and heals the user that much. Grass types are immune.

Outrage.name: Outrage
Outrage.desc: A rampage of 3-5 fiery blows. Leaves the user confused afterwards.

Petal Blizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
Petal Blizzard.desc: Throws a petal tornado that swallows the target, slices it, and blows apart.

Petal Dance.name: Petal Dance
Petal Dance.desc: Dances in with a storm of petals for a stream of hits. Leaves the user confused afterwards.

Razor Leaf.name: Razor Leaf
Razor Leaf.desc: Fires a spray of razor-sharp leaves. High critical-hit ratio.

Seed Bomb.name: Seed Bomb
Seed Bomb.desc: Lobs four hard seeds at where the target is heading; the last one is the biggest.

Sleep Powder.name: Sleep Powder
Sleep Powder.desc: Releases a drifting cloud of spores that puts the target to sleep. Can miss. Grass types are immune.

Sludge Bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
Sludge Bomb.desc: Lobs a glob of sludge that splatters on impact. 30% chance to poison.

Solar Beam.name: Solar Beam
Solar Beam.desc: Soaks up sunlight for a moment, then fires a sweeping beam.

Synthesis.name: Synthesis
Synthesis.desc: Restores 30% of max HP. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

Aerial Ace.name: Aerial Ace
Aerial Ace.desc: A slashing aerial dash that strikes from the side. Can't be dodged.

Air Slash.name: Air Slash
Air Slash.desc: Fires a volley of wind blades. The last blade has a 30% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Ancient Power.name: Ancient Power
Ancient Power.desc: Circling rocks are hurled at the target. 10% chance to raise all the user's stats by 1.

Crunch.name: Crunch
Crunch.desc: A crushing bite. 20% chance to lower Defense by 1 and 20% to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Dragon Breath.name: Dragon Breath
Dragon Breath.desc: Breathes three gusts of dragon fire. The last gust has a 30% chance to paralyze.

Dragon Claw.name: Dragon Claw
Dragon Claw.desc: A combo of slashing dragon claws.

Dragon Dance.name: Dragon Dance
Dragon Dance.desc: Raises Attack and Speed by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.

Dragon Pulse.name: Dragon Pulse
Dragon Pulse.desc: Fires a beam of dragon energy that ends in a blast. 20% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Dragon Rage.name: Dragon Rage
Dragon Rage.desc: Deals 40 HP of damage to the target.

Fire Blast.name: Fire Blast
Fire Blast.desc: Hurls a huge fireball that explodes on impact. 15% chance to burn.

Fire Fang.name: Fire Fang
Fire Fang.desc: A lunging bite with blazing fangs. 10% chance to burn, 10% chance to make the target flinch.

Fire Spin.name: Fire Spin
Fire Spin.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

Flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
Flamethrower.desc: Sprays a stream of fire over the target. Each hit has a small chance to burn.

Flare Blitz.name: Flare Blitz
Flare Blitz.desc: A blazing full-speed charge. The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt as recoil. 10% chance to burn.

Focus Blast.name: Focus Blast
Focus Blast.desc: Hurls a heavy ball of focused energy. 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Heat Wave.name: Heat Wave
Heat Wave.desc: Sends rolling waves of scorching heat over the target. 10% chance to burn per wave.

Metal Claw.name: Metal Claw
Metal Claw.desc: A quick swipe with gleaming steel claws. 10% chance to raise the user's Attack.

Overheat.name: Overheat
Overheat.desc: Unleashes everything in one huge cone of fire. 10% chance to burn. Lowers user's Sp. Atk by 2. Can't be dodged.

Seismic Toss.name: Seismic Toss
Seismic Toss.desc: Does damage equal to the user's level.

Slash.name: Slash
Slash.desc: A clean, sharp claw slash. High critical-hit ratio.

Thunder Punch.name: Thunder Punch
Thunder Punch.desc: A diving, electrified haymaker. 10% chance to paralyze.

Wing Attack.name: Wing Attack
Wing Attack.desc: Climbs high, dives, and strikes with two crossing wing cuts.

Aqua Tail.name: Aqua Tail
Aqua Tail.desc: Swings a tail wrapped in crashing water at a close target.

Aura Sphere.name: Aura Sphere
Aura Sphere.desc: Fires a ball of aura energy at the target. Can't be dodged.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.desc: A lunging bite. 30% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Blizzard.name: Blizzard
Blizzard.desc: Engulfs the target in a raging snowstorm of rapid hits. 10% chance to freeze.

Dark Pulse.name: Dark Pulse
Dark Pulse.desc: Fires waves of dark energy. The last wave has a 20% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Flash Cannon.name: Flash Cannon
Flash Cannon.desc: Fires a beam of steel light. 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Hydro Pump.name: Hydro Pump
Hydro Pump.desc: Blasts the target with a powerful jet of water. Can go wide.

Ice Beam.name: Ice Beam
Ice Beam.desc: Fires a freezing beam at the target. 15% chance to freeze.

Iron Defense.name: Iron Defense
Iron Defense.desc: Raises Defense by 2. Works twice per stay on the field.

Protect.name: Protect
Protect.desc: Raises a dome that blocks every attack while it stands. Waits 7 s, and 3 s longer after each use (back to 7 s on a switch).

Rain Dance.name: Rain Dance
Rain Dance.desc: Brings rain for 15 s: Water moves hit 1.5x harder, Fire moves half as hard.

Rapid Spin.name: Rapid Spin
Rapid Spin.desc: Spins in its shell and ricochets off the target. Clears Spikes and Toxic Spikes from your side and raises Speed by 1.

Shell Smash.name: Shell Smash
Shell Smash.desc: Raises Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed by 2; lowers Defense and Sp. Def by 1. Works twice per stay.

Skull Bash.name: Skull Bash
Skull Bash.desc: Gathers power, then rams head-first in a locked line. Can be sidestepped; a miss leaves it staggered.

Surf.name: Surf
Surf.desc: Rides a giant wave in and slams it down on the target.

Water Pulse.name: Water Pulse
Water Pulse.desc: Fires a pulsing ball of water. 20% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Agility.name: Agility
Agility.desc: Raises Speed by 2. Works twice per stay on the field.

Brave Bird.name: Brave Bird
Brave Bird.desc: A reckless full-speed dive into the target. The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt as recoil.

Hurricane.name: Hurricane
Hurricane.desc: Traps the target in a raging storm, then flings it out. 30% chance to confuse.

Mirror Move.name: Mirror Move
Mirror Move.desc: Copies the target's last move and uses it back.

Quick Attack.name: Quick Attack
Quick Attack.desc: Darts in so fast it leaves streaks of light, hitting from several sides.

Roost.name: Roost
Roost.desc: Lands and restores 30% of max HP. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

Tailwind.name: Tailwind
Tailwind.desc: A tailwind for 10 s: your side attacks noticeably more often.

Discharge.name: Discharge
Discharge.desc: Releases a burst of electricity all around the user. 30% chance to paralyze.

Double Team.name: Double Team
Double Team.desc: Raises evasion by 1: attacks become more likely to hit a decoy. Works twice per stay on the field.

Electro Ball.name: Electro Ball
Electro Ball.desc: Charges a crackling ball of electricity and hurls it at the target. The faster the user is than its target, the stronger: 40 power when slower, 60, 80, 120, up to 150 at four times its Speed.

Extreme Speed.name: Extreme Speed
Extreme Speed.desc: Three blinding-fast dashes through the target from different angles.

Feint.name: Feint
Feint.desc: Sends a decoy in, then strikes from the side. Breaks through a raised guard.

Iron Tail.name: Iron Tail
Iron Tail.desc: Swings a steel-hard tail into the target. 30% chance to lower its Defense.

Nasty Plot.name: Nasty Plot
Nasty Plot.desc: Raises Sp. Atk by 2. Works twice per stay on the field.

Thunder.name: Thunder
Thunder.desc: A huge bolt from a storm cloud above the target. 30% chance to paralyze. Sometimes misses.

Thunder Wave.name: Thunder Wave
Thunder Wave.desc: Sends a crackling wave that paralyzes the target. Fails on Ground types.

Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
Thunderbolt.desc: A crackling stream of bolts ending in a big strike. Each zap may paralyze (4-10%).

Volt Tackle.name: Volt Tackle
Volt Tackle.desc: An electrified full-body charge. 20% chance to paralyze. The user takes 1/3 of the damage as recoil.

Wild Charge.name: Wild Charge
Wild Charge.desc: A reckless electrified charge. The user takes 1/4 of the damage as recoil.

Drill Run.name: Drill Run
Drill Run.desc: Spins like a drill and rams through the target. Lands critical hits more often.

Fury Cutter.name: Fury Cutter
Fury Cutter.desc: Slashes with glowing blades. Each cut in a row is stronger: 40, then 80, then 120 power. Another move, a miss, or 8 s without it starts over.

Gyro Ball.name: Gyro Ball
Gyro Ball.desc: Spins its whole body like a top and grinds into the target. Same power whatever either Pokémon's Speed.

Hail.name: Hail
Hail.desc: Summons hail for 15 s: every 3 s it chips 1/16 HP off every Pokémon that isn't Ice type.

Icicle Crash.name: Icicle Crash
Icicle Crash.desc: Drops heavy icicles onto the target from above. 30% chance to make it flinch (a brief stagger).

Iron Head.name: Iron Head
Iron Head.desc: Charges headfirst with a steel-hard head. 30% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Metal Burst.name: Metal Burst
Metal Burst.desc: Braces in a blade stance for 1.4 s. If hit during it, strikes back for 1.5x the damage taken. Fails if not hit.

Rollout.name: Rollout
Rollout.desc: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.

Stone Edge.name: Stone Edge
Stone Edge.desc: Sharp stone spires burst up under the target. High critical-hit ratio.

Swift.name: Swift
Swift.desc: Fires a burst of star-shaped rays. Can't be dodged.

Swords Dance.name: Swords Dance
Swords Dance.desc: Raises Attack by 2. Works twice per stay on the field.

X-Scissor.name: X-Scissor
X-Scissor.desc: Crosses its claws and slashes in an X. High critical-hit ratio.

Double Kick.name: Double Kick
Double Kick.desc: Two quick kicks in a row.

Poison Fang.name: Poison Fang
Poison Fang.desc: A venomous bite. 50% chance to badly poison, 10% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Rock Smash.name: Rock Smash
Rock Smash.desc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

Shadow Ball.name: Shadow Ball
Shadow Ball.desc: Hurls a shadowy orb, or a cluster of smaller orbs, at the target.

Superpower.name: Superpower
Superpower.desc: A crushing flurry of blows. Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

Toxic.name: Toxic
Toxic.desc: Spits venom that badly poisons the target; the poison damage grows over time.

Toxic Spikes.name: Toxic Spikes
Toxic Spikes.desc: Scatters poison spikes on the foe's side. Grounded Pokémon coming in get poisoned. A grounded Poison type coming in absorbs them.

Focus Energy.name: Focus Energy
Focus Energy.desc: Focuses hard: critical hits become far more likely until it switches out. Works twice per stay on the field.

Megahorn.name: Megahorn
Megahorn.desc: Charges horn-first and gores the target, sometimes tossing it overhead.

Poison Jab.name: Poison Jab
Poison Jab.desc: A close stab with a venom-coated horn. 30% chance to poison.

Throat Chop.name: Throat Chop
Throat Chop.desc: Steps in and chops the target across the throat.

Cosmic Power.name: Cosmic Power
Cosmic Power.desc: Raises Defense and Sp. Def by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.

Follow Me.name: Follow Me
Follow Me.desc: Draws the foes' attacks onto the user for about 8 seconds. Only has an effect in double battles.

Meteor Mash.name: Meteor Mash
Meteor Mash.desc: A comet-like dash punch. 20% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

Metronome.name: Metronome
Metronome.desc: Wags a finger and uses a random move.

Moonblast.name: Moonblast
Moonblast.desc: Gathers the moon's power and hurls a huge glowing orb. 30% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk.

Moonlight.name: Moonlight
Moonlight.desc: Restores 30% of max HP. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

Psychic.name: Psychic
Psychic.desc: Grabs the target with telekinesis and flings it; a far-off or attacking target can break free. 10% chance: Sp. Def down.

Sing.name: Sing
Sing.desc: Sends a song at the target to put it to sleep. Often misses.

Aurora Veil.name: Aurora Veil
Aurora Veil.desc: Raises a veil that halves physical and special damage to the user's side for 12 seconds.

Confuse Ray.name: Confuse Ray
Confuse Ray.desc: Sends ghostly orbs at the target's head: it staggers and becomes confused.

Dazzling Gleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
Dazzling Gleam.desc: A burst of dazzling light pours out from the user at its foes.

Extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
Extrasensory.desc: A stream of psychic power, then a heavy psychic blow. 10% chance to make the target flinch.

Freeze-Dry.name: Freeze-Dry
Freeze-Dry.desc: Exhales a cone of freezing fog. Super effective on Water types; 10% chance to freeze.

Hex.name: Hex
Hex.desc: A close-range grab that seizes the target. Power is 1.5x if the target has a status condition.

Hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
Hypnosis.desc: Waves of hypnotic rings try to put the target to sleep. Doesn't always take hold.

Ice Shard.name: Ice Shard
Ice Shard.desc: Flings a burst of sharp ice shards at the target in a flash.

Icy Wind.name: Icy Wind
Icy Wind.desc: Blows a freezing wind at the target, lowering its Speed.

Payback.name: Payback
Payback.desc: Strikes back at the target. Power doubles if the user was hit in the last 2 seconds.

Dig.name: Dig
Dig.desc: Burrows underground, safe from attacks except Earthquake, then bursts up under the target.

Mud Bomb.name: Mud Bomb
Mud Bomb.desc: Spits a lobbed glob of mud that splatters on impact.

Night Slash.name: Night Slash
Night Slash.desc: Vanishes, reappears behind the target and slashes. High critical-hit ratio.

Rock Slide.name: Rock Slide
Rock Slide.desc: Burrows and pops up around the target, flinging boulders. Last one: 30% chance to flinch (a brief stagger).

Sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
Sandstorm.desc: Whips up a sandstorm for 15 s: every 3 s it chips 1/16 HP off all but Rock, Ground and Steel types.

Sucker Punch.name: Sucker Punch
Sucker Punch.desc: A sneaky strike that only works while the target is attacking. Used at any other moment, it fails.

Tri Attack.name: Tri Attack
Tri Attack.desc: Fires a spinning triangle of fire, ice and lightning. 20% chance to burn, freeze or paralyze.

Pay Day.name: Pay Day
Pay Day.desc: Flings a fountain of coins; five of them pelt the target.

Play Rough.name: Play Rough
Play Rough.desc: Pounces into a brawling dust cloud. 10% chance to lower the target's Attack.

Power Gem.name: Power Gem
Power Gem.desc: Fires a volley of cut gems along a prismatic ray.

Close Combat.name: Close Combat
Close Combat.desc: A flurry of close-range blows. Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

Flame Wheel.name: Flame Wheel
Flame Wheel.desc: Rolls into a wheel of fire and chases down the target. 10% chance to burn per hit.

Retaliate.name: Retaliate
Retaliate.desc: A flurry of swipes ending in a big one. Double power if a teammate fainted in the last 10 s.

Thunder Fang.name: Thunder Fang
Thunder Fang.desc: An electric bite. 10% chance to paralyze, 10% chance to flinch (a brief stagger).

Calm Mind.name: Calm Mind
Calm Mind.desc: Raises Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.

Future Sight.name: Future Sight
Future Sight.desc: Foresees an attack: about 4 seconds later, a psychic blast strikes whoever is on the target's side.

Psycho Cut.name: Psycho Cut
Psycho Cut.desc: Conjures psychic blades and flings them one by one, the last the biggest. High critical-hit ratio.

Psyshock.name: Psyshock
Psyshock.desc: Fires a fan of psychic shards that stick in the target, then detonate together.

Recover.name: Recover
Recover.desc: Restores 30% of max HP. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

Reflect.name: Reflect
Reflect.desc: Puts up a wall that halves physical damage to your side for 12 s.

Giga Drain.name: Giga Drain
Giga Drain.desc: Drains energy from the target in a stream. The user heals half the damage dealt.

Sludge Wave.name: Sludge Wave
Sludge Wave.desc: Slams down and sends a ring wave of sludge across the whole field. 10% chance to poison.

Supersonic.name: Supersonic
Supersonic.desc: Emits strange sound waves that confuse the target for a few seconds.

Fire Punch.name: Fire Punch
Fire Punch.desc: A flaming dash punch. 10% chance to burn.

Heavy Slam.name: Heavy Slam
Heavy Slam.desc: Slams its heavy body down onto the target. The heavier it is than the target, the stronger: 40 power, up to 120 at five times the weight.

Self-Destruct.name: Self-Destruct
Self-Destruct.desc: A huge explosion around the user that hurts more up close. The user faints. Can't be dodged.

Drill Peck.name: Drill Peck
Drill Peck.desc: Drills into the target with a spinning beak, then knocks it back.

Pursuit.name: Pursuit
Pursuit.desc: Slips through the shadows and strikes from behind. Double power on a target that is running away.

Gunk Shot.name: Gunk Shot
Gunk Shot.desc: Hurls a heavy glob of filth. 30% chance to poison. Can go wide.

Ice Punch.name: Ice Punch
Ice Punch.desc: An icy dash punch. 10% chance to freeze.

Mud Shot.name: Mud Shot
Mud Shot.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

Curse.name: Curse
Curse.desc: Raises Attack and Defense by 1 but lowers Speed by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.

Lick.name: Lick
Lick.desc: Lunges in for a ghostly lick. 30% chance to paralyze.

Shadow Punch.name: Shadow Punch
Shadow Punch.desc: Punches into a portal; the fist bursts out near the target and homes in. Can't be dodged.

Egg Bomb.name: Egg Bomb
Egg Bomb.desc: Lobs an exploding egg at the target. A near miss still catches it in the blast.

Sunny Day.name: Sunny Day
Sunny Day.desc: Brings harsh sun for 15 s: Fire moves hit 1.5x harder, Water moves half as hard.

Wood Hammer.name: Wood Hammer
Wood Hammer.desc: Slams down a massive wooden hammer. The user takes 1/3 of the damage as recoil.

Hammer Arm.name: Hammer Arm
Hammer Arm.desc: Brings a heavy fist down on the target. Lowers the user's Speed by 1.

Brick Break.name: Brick Break
Brick Break.desc: A heavy chop that also smashes through a raised guard.

Razor Wind.name: Razor Wind
Razor Wind.desc: Whips up a vortex, then sweeps three big wind blades at the target. High critical-hit ratio.

Raging Bull.name: Raging Bull
Raging Bull.desc: Stamps, bellows, then charges horns-first from far off and tosses the target overhead.

Rest.name: Rest
Rest.desc: Restores 30% of max HP and cures status, then sleeps for about 7.5 s. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

Zen Headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
Zen Headbutt.desc: Gathers its mind, then rushes in headfirst. 20% chance to flinch (a brief stagger).

Ice Fang.name: Ice Fang
Ice Fang.desc: A flurry of icy bites. 10% chance to freeze; each bite may make the target flinch (10%).

Waterfall.name: Waterfall
Waterfall.desc: Crashes into the target with a rush of water. 20% chance to flinch (a brief stagger).

Whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
Whirlpool.desc: Opens a whirlpool under the target, trapping it for a moment and dealing extra damage as it spins.

Perish Song.name: Perish Song
Perish Song.desc: A song every Pokémon on the field hears, the user too: each faints in 10 s unless it goes back in its ball first (Shadow Tag and Arena Trap can't stop that). A Pokémon sent in afterwards is safe. Waits 20 s.

Pin Missile.name: Pin Missile
Pin Missile.desc: Three volleys of glowing needles, each from a new angle. Each needle can be dodged.

Dual Wingbeat.name: Dual Wingbeat
Dual Wingbeat.desc: Two quick wing strikes, the second one harder.

Headbutt.name: Headbutt
Headbutt.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

High Horsepower.name: High Horsepower
High Horsepower.desc: A thundering charge that ends in a ground-shaking stomp.

Sleep Talk.name: Sleep Talk
Sleep Talk.desc: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.

Draco Meteor.name: Draco Meteor
Draco Meteor.desc: Calls down a rain of meteors around the target. Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

Dragon Rush.name: Dragon Rush
Dragon Rush.desc: A crushing full-speed charge. 20% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

Eruption.name: Eruption
Eruption.desc: Rains molten rocks on the target. Weaker the less HP the user has. 10% chance to burn per rock.

Flame Charge.name: Flame Charge
Flame Charge.desc: A flaming dash into the target. Raises the user's Speed by 1.

Lava Plume.name: Lava Plume
Lava Plume.desc: A ring of lava bursts out around the user, then molten bombs rain down. Each part has a 10-12% chance to burn.

Acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
Acrobatics.desc: Springs into the air, swoops at the target twice, then dives in for a heavy finishing blow.

Cross Poison.name: Cross Poison
Cross Poison.desc: Slashing passes in an X. Lands critical hits more often. 10% chance to poison per hit.

Leech Life.name: Leech Life
Leech Life.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

U-turn.name: U-turn
U-turn.desc: Swoops in on a curve, strikes, and loops back to where it started.

Morning Sun.name: Morning Sun
Morning Sun.desc: Restores 30% of max HP. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

Foul Play.name: Foul Play
Foul Play.desc: Dashes through the target's shadow and strikes from behind, using the target's own Attack.

Autotomize.name: Autotomize
Autotomize.desc: Sheds weight to raise Speed by 2. Works twice per stay on the field.

Magnet Rise.name: Magnet Rise
Magnet Rise.desc: Floats on magnetism for 10 s: Ground moves can't touch the user.

Steel Wing.name: Steel Wing
Steel Wing.desc: Strikes with wings hard as steel. 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

Counter.name: Counter
Counter.desc: Takes a guard stance for 1.4 s. If struck by a physical attack, strikes back for double the damage taken.

Metal Sound.name: Metal Sound
Metal Sound.desc: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.

Spikes.name: Spikes
Spikes.desc: Scatters spikes on the foe's side. Grounded Pokémon coming in lose 1/16 of their HP (1/8 with 2 layers, 1/6 with 3).

Knock Off.name: Knock Off
Knock Off.desc: A heavy dark backhand swat that knocks the target flying.

Energy Ball.name: Energy Ball
Energy Ball.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Leaf Blade.name: Leaf Blade
Leaf Blade.desc: Dashes in with a glowing leaf blade, or a quick flurry of slashes. High critical-hit ratio.

Substitute.name: Substitute
Substitute.desc: Pays 1/4 of max HP to leave a decoy that takes hits until it breaks. Works once per battle.

Blaze Kick.name: Blaze Kick
Blaze Kick.desc: A flaming dash kick. Lands critical hits more often. 10% chance to burn.

Bounce.name: Bounce
Bounce.desc: Springs high out of reach, then drops onto the target. 30% chance to paralyze.

High Jump Kick.name: High Jump Kick
High Jump Kick.desc: A soaring knee kick. If it misses, the user crashes and loses 1/3 of its max HP.

Sky Uppercut.name: Sky Uppercut
Sky Uppercut.desc: Can hit Pokémon using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.

Amnesia.name: Amnesia
Amnesia.desc: Raises Sp. Def by 2. Works twice per stay on the field.

Flip Turn.name: Flip Turn
Flip Turn.desc: A quick flipping water strike on the target.

Muddy Water.name: Muddy Water
Muddy Water.desc: Calls a huge wave of mud that rolls across the field and drags the target along.

Facade.name: Facade
Facade.desc: A diving strike. Power doubles while the user is burned, poisoned or paralyzed.

Spit Up.name: Spit Up
Spit Up.desc: More power with more uses of Stockpile.

Draining Kiss.name: Draining Kiss
Draining Kiss.desc: A kiss that drains energy. The user heals 3/4 of the damage dealt.

Hyper Voice.name: Hyper Voice
Hyper Voice.desc: Three booming sound blasts at the target, the last one the strongest.

Mystical Fire.name: Mystical Fire
Mystical Fire.desc: Raises a column of magic flame under the target. Lowers its Sp. Atk by 1.

Dynamic Punch.name: Dynamic Punch
Dynamic Punch.desc: A charging punch with an explosive impact. Always confuses the target.

Force Palm.name: Force Palm
Force Palm.desc: A point-blank palm strike that sends a shock wave through the target. 30% chance to paralyze.

Spore.name: Spore
Spore.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

Phantom Force.name: Phantom Force
Phantom Force.desc: Vanishes into the dark, where it can't be hit, then lunges out from behind the target. Walking away won't save you: only a well-timed dodge as it comes out.

Shadow Sneak.name: Shadow Sneak
Shadow Sneak.desc: Sinks into its own shadow, where it can't be hit, and rises out of the target's to strike.

Boomburst.name: Boomburst
Boomburst.desc: Unleashes a deafening sonic blast that bursts out all around the user.

Body Press.name: Body Press
Body Press.desc: Flies up and crashes its heavy body down onto the target. Uses its own Defense instead of its Attack, stat boosts included.

Head Smash.name: Head Smash
Head Smash.desc: A full-force headbutt. The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt as recoil.

Shock Wave.name: Shock Wave
Shock Wave.desc: A fast jolt of electricity. 10% chance to paralyze. Can't be dodged.

Aqua Jet.name: Aqua Jet
Aqua Jet.desc: A quick water-wrapped dash into the target.

Liquidation.name: Liquidation
Liquidation.desc: A crashing water dash that bursts on impact. 20% chance to lower the target's Defense.

Water Spout.name: Water Spout
Water Spout.desc: Blasts a spout of water that rains down as water bombs. Weaker the lower the user's HP.

Bug Buzz.name: Bug Buzz
Bug Buzz.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Sky Attack.name: Sky Attack
Sky Attack.desc: Flies out of sight, where it can't be hit, then dives down. 30% chance to flinch (a brief stagger).

Crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
Crabhammer.desc: Brings a huge pincer down on the target. Lands critical hits more often.

Ingrain.name: Ingrain
Ingrain.desc: Plants roots that restore 1/64 of max HP every 2 seconds for the rest of its stay on the field.

Crush Claw.name: Crush Claw
Crush Claw.desc: A crushing claw slam at close range. 50% chance to lower the target's Defense.

Mirror Coat.name: Mirror Coat
Mirror Coat.desc: Raises a mirror for 1.4 s. A special hit is sent back for double damage; a physical hit shatters it.

Scald.name: Scald
Scald.desc: Sprays a jet of boiling water. 30% chance to burn.

Fly.name: Fly
Fly.desc: Flies up out of reach, then swoops down onto the target.

Psychic Fangs.name: Psychic Fangs
Psychic Fangs.desc: Lunges and snaps huge psychic jaws shut on the target.

Aqua Cutter.name: Aqua Cutter
Aqua Cutter.desc: A rush of water slashes ending in a big cut. Lands critical hits more often.

Ice Spinner.name: Ice Spinner
Ice Spinner.desc: Spins on ice and slams into the target.

Dizzy Punch.name: Dizzy Punch
Dizzy Punch.desc: A rhythmic dash punch. 20% chance to confuse the target.

Pain Split.name: Pain Split
Pain Split.desc: Shares HP: the user and target both end up with the average of their HP.

Silver Wind.name: Silver Wind
Silver Wind.desc: A stream of glittering wind. 10% chance to raise all of the user's stats by 1.

Will-O-Wisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
Will-O-Wisp.desc: Sends ghostly flames that home in and burn the target.

Bone Rush.name: Bone Rush
Bone Rush.desc: A flurry of 2 to 5 bone strikes at close range.

Drain Punch.name: Drain Punch
Drain Punch.desc: A draining punch. The user heals half the damage dealt.

Low Kick.name: Low Kick
Low Kick.desc: A low sweep at the legs. The heavier the target, the more it hurts.

Triple Axel.name: Triple Axel
Triple Axel.desc: Three spinning kicks, each harder than the last. A miss ends the combo.

Heat Crash.name: Heat Crash
Heat Crash.desc: Leaps and crashes down on the target in a blaze. 10% chance to burn.

Rock Wrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
Rock Wrecker.desc: Builds a giant boulder and hurls it. Leaves the user unable to act for a moment afterwards.

Avalanche.name: Avalanche
Avalanche.desc: Drops a mass of snow and ice on the target. Power doubles if the user was hit in the last 2 seconds.

Sacred Sword.name: Sacred Sword
Sacred Sword.desc: Glides in and brings a huge blade down. Ignores the target's Defense stat changes.

Night Daze.name: Night Daze
Night Daze.desc: Slams the ground and sends a wave of darkness rolling over the whole floor.

Gear Grind.name: Gear Grind
Gear Grind.desc: Hurls two spinning gears that strike the target one after the other.

Shift Gear.name: Shift Gear
Shift Gear.desc: Raises Attack by 1 and Speed by 2. Works twice per stay on the field.

Water Shuriken.name: Water Shuriken
Water Shuriken.desc: Forms a star of water and throws it spinning at the target.

Spiky Shield.name: Spiky Shield
Spiky Shield.desc: Raises a spiked shield for 1.4 s, as long as Protect. Blocks hits; contact attackers are hurt by 1/8 of their max HP. Waits 7 s, and 3 s longer after each use (back to 7 s on a switch).

Cut.name: Cut
Cut.desc: Dashes through the target with a quick slash.

King's Shield.name: King's Shield
King's Shield.desc: Raises a shield for 1.4 s, as long as Protect. Blocks hits; contact attackers lose 1 Attack. Waits 7 s, and 3 s longer after each use (back to 7 s on a switch).

Flying Press.name: Flying Press
Flying Press.desc: Leaps up and crashes down with its whole body. Fighting and Flying type at once.

Karate Chop.name: Karate Chop
Karate Chop.desc: Quick dashing chops. Lands critical hits more often.

Poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
Poltergeist.desc: Rips chunks out of the floor around the target and hurls them in from every side.

Pollen Puff.name: Pollen Puff
Pollen Puff.desc: Lobs a big puff of pollen that bursts into a cloud on the target.

Quiver Dance.name: Quiver Dance
Quiver Dance.desc: Raises Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.

Accelerock.name: Accelerock
Accelerock.desc: A lightning-fast rocky dash straight into the target.

Floral Healing.name: Floral Healing
Floral Healing.desc: A bloom of light heals the user by 30% of its max HP. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

First Impression.name: First Impression
First Impression.desc: Wings flare, then a sudden lunging strike at the target.

Clanging Scales.name: Clanging Scales
Clanging Scales.desc: Rattles its scales to blast the target with sound. Lowers the user's Defense by 1.

Clangorous Soul.name: Clangorous Soul
Clangorous Soul.desc: Costs 1/3 of max HP to raise all stats by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

Drum Beating.name: Drum Beating
Drum Beating.desc: Drum-controlled roots strike the target. Lowers the target's Speed by 1.

Grassy Glide.name: Grassy Glide
Grassy Glide.desc: Rides a carpet of grass across the arena into the target. Fast and hard to see coming.

Snipe Shot.name: Snipe Shot
Snipe Shot.desc: Takes aim and fires one high-pressure water slug. High critical-hit ratio. Can't be dodged.

Dragon Darts.name: Dragon Darts
Dragon Darts.desc: Launches two dragon darts at the target, one after the other.

Kowtow Cleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
Kowtow Cleave.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

Fiery Dance.name: Fiery Dance
Fiery Dance.desc: A dance of swirling flames ending in a fiery blast. 50% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

Spirit Break.name: Spirit Break
Spirit Break.desc: Two blade cuts and a shattering punch. Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

Spectral Thief.name: Spectral Thief
Spectral Thief.desc: A telegraphed shadow lunge. On hit, steals up to 2 positive stat stages total. Can be dodged; no invulnerability.

Bulk Up.name: Bulk Up
Bulk Up.desc: Raises Attack and Defense by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.
